card.name: Technical adjectives before hyphenated nouns
card.fires_on: Adjectives like wide, high, variable or rectangular that start a technical compound, as in wide-temperature, wideband, high-speed or rectangular-to-coaxial. Seen mostly in engineering and physics text.

modes.label: wide before band or hyphen
modes.description: The word wide opens a compound such as wideband or wide-temperature.

modes.label: high before hyphen
modes.description: The word high opens a compound such as high-speed or high-resolution.

modes.description: Adjectives like variable or rectangular that describe an instrument or adapter part.

card.writes: It adds a hyphen or compound-ending, such as -wave, -direction or -angle, after the adjective.
card.plain: It spots an engineering adjective like wide or high that is about to be joined to a noun, as in wideband or high-speed.
